rule.en:
0 to 10: **zero** (**oh** in a phone number), **one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten**. Then **eleven, twelve**, and 13 to 19 end in **-teen**: **thirteen, fourteen, fifteen, sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen**.

The tens end in **-ty**: **twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety**. Watch the spelling: **forty** has no u (but **four**, **fourteen**), **fifteen** and **fifty** an f, **eighteen** one t. The stress keeps them apart: thir**teen**, but **thir**ty.

From 21 to 99 the ten comes first, with a hyphen: **twenty-one**, **thirty-five**, **ninety-nine**.

**a hundred** or **one hundred** (100), **a thousand** (1,000). British English says **and** after the hundreds: **a hundred and five**, **two hundred and fifty**. After a number, **hundred** and **thousand** never take -s: **three hundred sheep**.

From two on, the noun is plural: **one sheep**, **two dogs**, **five miles**. Ask **How many …?**: **How many sheep have you got?** Age takes be: **I'm thirty-four.**
rule.sl:
0 do 10: **zero** (v telefonski številki **oh**), **one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten**. Nato **eleven, twelve**, od 13 do 19 pa **-teen**: **thirteen, fourteen, fifteen, sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen**.

Desetice se končajo na **-ty**: **twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety**. Pazi na zapis: **forty** je brez u (a **four**, **fourteen**), **fifteen** in **fifty** imata f, **eighteen** en t. Loči jih naglas: thir**teen** (13), a **thir**ty (30).

Od 21 do 99 je drugače kot v slovenščini najprej desetica, z vezajem: **twenty-one** (enaindvajset), **thirty-five** (petintrideset), **ninety-nine**.

**a hundred** ali **one hundred** (100), **a thousand** (1000). Britanska angleščina reče za stoticami **and**: **a hundred and five** (105), **two hundred and fifty** (250). **hundred** in **thousand** za številom nikoli ne dobita -s: **three hundred sheep** (tristo ovc).

Od dva naprej je samostalnik v množini, brez rodilnika: **one sheep**, **two dogs**, **five miles** (pet milj). Koliko: **How many …?**: **How many sheep have you got?** (Koliko ovc imaš?) Starost z be: **I'm thirty-four.** (Imam štiriintrideset let.)
rule.de:
0 bis 10: **zero** (am Telefon **oh**), **one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten**. Dann **eleven, twelve**, und 13 bis 19 enden auf **-teen**: **thirteen, fourteen, fifteen, sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen**.

Die Zehner enden auf **-ty**: **twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety**. Achtung: **forty** ohne u (aber **four**, **fourteen**), **fifteen** und **fifty** mit f, **eighteen** mit einem t. Die Betonung trennt sie: thir**teen** (13), aber **thir**ty (30).

Von 21 bis 99 kommt anders als im Deutschen der Zehner zuerst, mit Bindestrich: **twenty-one** (einundzwanzig), **thirty-five** (fünfunddreißig), **ninety-nine**.

**a hundred** oder **one hundred** (100), **a thousand** (1000). Britisches Englisch sagt nach den Hundertern **and**: **a hundred and five** (105), **two hundred and fifty** (250). Nach einer Zahl bekommen **hundred** und **thousand** nie ein -s: **three hundred sheep**.

Ab zwei steht das Nomen im Plural: **one sheep**, **two dogs**, **five miles**. Wie viele: **How many …?**: **How many sheep have you got?** (Wie viele Schafe hast du?) Das Alter mit be: **I'm thirty-four.** (Ich bin vierunddreißig.)
rule.it:
Da 0 a 10: **zero** (in un numero di telefono **oh**), **one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten**. Poi **eleven, twelve**, e da 13 a 19 finiscono in **-teen**: **thirteen, fourteen, fifteen, sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen**.

Le decine finiscono in **-ty**: **twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety**. Attenzione all'ortografia: **forty** senza u (ma **four**, **fourteen**), **fifteen** e **fifty** con la f, **eighteen** con una t sola. L'accento le distingue: thir**teen** (13), ma **thir**ty (30).

Da 21 a 99 prima la decina, come in italiano, ma con un trattino: **twenty-one** (ventuno), **thirty-five** (trentacinque), **ninety-nine**.

**a hundred** o **one hundred** (100), **a thousand** (1000). L'inglese britannico dice **and** dopo le centinaia: **a hundred and five** (105), **two hundred and fifty** (250). Dopo un numero **hundred** e **thousand** non prendono mai la -s: **three hundred sheep**.

Da due in su il nome è plurale: **one sheep**, **two dogs**, **five miles**. Quanti: **How many …?**: **How many sheep have you got?** (Quante pecore hai?) L'età va con be: **I'm thirty-four.** (Ho trentaquattro anni.)
